tileCopyFollowup: CHAMPIONSHIP_RANCH_TILE_COMPOSITION.v1.json now verifies and ports ordinary/filler/wall tile-copy loops, cropping and wrapping. The old full-compositor unknown below now concerns production material input, objects, animation, field-record lifecycle and renderer integration.
scope: R2A native board placement and Training tile-origin arithmetic
supersedesClaims: A cage always occupies exactly one hex cell.
Board coordinates are unknown or use alternating-column vertical staggering.
A Training field is necessarily unrelated to the original board anchor.

originalDataflow.shapeWriter: ARM9 0x02050030: definition index -> byte at 0x020C8CBC + index*40 -> cage record +8
originalDataflow.editorRestore: OVL15 0x0210C834..0x0210C898 reads shape and anchor, calls 0x0210C118
originalDataflow.editorPlacement: OVL15 0x0210C118 tests mask[shape] & (occupied >> anchor); conflict returns 0 before writes
originalDataflow.editorCommit: OVL15 0x0210D640..0x0210D654 writes definition and anchor through existing native record setters
originalDataflow.fieldInputs: ARM9 0x02082150..0x02082190 copies the same record's field, anchor and shape into field arrays
originalDataflow.fieldOrigin: ARM9 0x020827B0..0x020827F4 reads anchor and shape mask to form destination tile index

board.limits: Single placement helper only. Caller row normalization, fixed reserved cells, remove/restore and commit must accompany future editor migration.

field.sourceCropObservation: ARM9 0x02082894..0x020828B4 skips three source tile rows when row is zero
field.horizontalWrapObservation: ARM9 0x020828F0..0x0208291C wraps a destination index back by one row stride when crossing the right edge
field.specialFieldHandling: Waiting Room and empty-space filler are not ordinary independent shelf tiles
field.topEdgeFootTruncation: VERIFIED_BINARY: OVL18 0x0211208C..0x021120B4 (terrain test after a move) and 0x02111AB4..0x02111AD4 (clearance read) form the tile row with asr #2 / add lsr #29 / asr #3, a signed divide by 8 that truncates toward zero, so a resident's feet may stand at y=-7..-1 and still read row 0. src/championship/raising/nativeRaisingMovement.js tile() matches; the walk rule is unchanged.

presentationHeadroom.reason: Residents are drawn from their feet and the walkable floor reaches the board's top edge, so with only the centring margin above the board the frame edge cut tall bodies off under the status bar.
presentationHeadroom.rule: The native ranch reserves RAISING_TOP_HEADROOM_NATIVE (tallest main-side body 77, m503/m518, plus the 7-pixel top-edge foot overhang = 84) above the board and takes the largest whole screen-pixel scale at which board and headroom fit; a frame that cannot hold both at two whole pixels keeps two and scrolls vertically. Art, residents, shadows, food, feedback and input share the one placement.
presentationHeadroom.doesNotChange: Movement, terrain, positions, RNG, save data or any gameplay value.

implementation.legacySavePolicy: Preserve existing records; do not silently drop, move or relabel them as original-valid
implementation.presentationPolicy: Keep current shelf layout labelled PRODUCT_AUTHORED until complete compositor, save compatibility and original screen/live trace checks pass
